newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan August c/a surplus seen shrinking.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan August c/a surplus seen shrinking.

text.p: Japan's current account surplus in August is expected to have dropped, with a Reuters poll on Friday showing economists forecasting a surplus of about 476 billion yen on average against 648 billion yen a year earlier.
The August data is due to be announced at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT Tuesday) next week.
Analysts said increasing imports and slowing exports would continue to help reduce Japan's surplus from year-ago levels.
"However, the pace of the fall in the surplus has been slowing down for the past several months, and this trend will be seen in August as well," an analyst at Nomura Research said.
